SharedLink.title: SharedLink
SharedLink.description: A file uploaded to Catbox.moe / Litterbox and saved to the user's cloud link-sharing history.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this shared link.

fileName.description: Original name of the uploaded file.

fileSizeBytes.description: Size of the uploaded file in bytes.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded file.

url.description: The public shareable HTTPS link returned by Catbox.moe or Litterbox.

expiresAtEpochMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when temporary Litterbox link expires, or 0 for permanent Catbox links.

note.description: Optional user note or label for this shared link.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the link record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the link record was last updated.

/users/{userId}/shared_links/{linkId}.description: Per-user history of files shared via Catbox.moe / Litterbox links.
